name: Ghost
tagline: Ghost is an open-source publishing platform for professional creators building newsletters, memberships, and paid subscription products. Writers and independent publishers use it to run a media business on their own infrastructure, with built-in email newsletters, subscription payment processing, SEO optimization, and analytics without depending on third-party platforms that can change terms or take a larger revenue cut. AI writing assistance helps draft and edit content directly in the editor without switching to a separate writing tool.
